mechanisms.name: surprise_gated_arbitration
mechanisms.title: Surprise-Gated Arbitration
mechanisms.description: The working memory mixture weight is dynamically boosted on each trial based on the absolute RL prediction error and the confidence of the working memory for the current state.
mechanisms.evidence:
pe = r - Q_s[a]
sorted_W = np.sort(W_s)[::-1]
conf = max(0.0, sorted_W[0] - (sorted_W[1] if len(sorted_W) > 1 else 0.0))
wm_boost = surprise_gate * abs(pe) * conf
wm_weight_t = max(0.0, min(1.0, wm_weight_block + wm_boost))
mechanisms.reason: The mixture weight depends on the prediction error (pe), which requires the reward (r). In a standard causal backbone, choice probabilities and mixture weights must be computed before the reward is observed. This acausal dependence (using the outcome to determine the probability of the choice that led to it) cannot be faithfully expressed in standard pre-choice slots.
